items.work: Il barbiere di Siviglia — complete opera
items.performers: Teresa Berganza, Hermann Prey, Luigi Alva, Enzo Dara, Paolo Montarsolo; Ambrosian Opera Chorus; London Symphony Orchestra; Claudio Abbado
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: Ruffo’s Figaro and the overture in the Hall are entrances to a much larger comedy. Stay for Berganza’s Rosina, the plotting duets and the first-act finale, where separate anxieties become one rhythmic machine. Abbado gives the ensemble room to articulate every syllable without letting the action sag.

items.work: Guglielmo Tell — complete opera, Italian version
items.performers: Sherrill Milnes, Luciano Pavarotti, Mirella Freni, Nicolai Ghiaurov; Ambrosian Opera Chorus; National Philharmonic Orchestra; Riccardo Chailly
items.label: Decca
items.note: The overture cannot supply Tell’s ordeal as a father or Arnold’s divided loyalties. Milnes, Pavarotti and Freni make the full opera a vocal as well as an orchestral event. This is the Italian translation, not Rossini’s original French text; Pavarotti’s Arnold is the particular reason to choose it.
